# M5 — Social & Discovery

> Launched 2026-08-22. Status: ACTIVE.

## Objective
Create a collector-centric social layer based on collections and discovery, not generic social-media posting.

## Scope
- #326 — Collector Profiles & Public Collections (P1)
- #327 — Follows & Activity Feed (P1)
- #330 — Social Moderation, Privacy & Abuse Controls (P1)
- #328 — Likes, Comments, Groups & Communities (P2)
- #329 — Discovery Recommendations (P2)

## Entry criteria (met)
1. ✅ M0–M4 all complete
2. ✅ SEC-EPIC-7 authorization/privacy complete (#337 closed)
3. ✅ Ownership visibility model proven (#338 centralized auth, #339 privacy model)
4. ✅ Abuse/rate controls operational (#341 rate-limiting, #385 asset rate-limit)
5. ✅ Reporting/moderation model defined (in scope as #330)
6. ✅ Private collection data cannot leak through social features (#338 property-level gate)
7. ✅ Zero open PRs on main

## Sequencing
- Phase 1 (parallel): #326 + #330 — distinct concerns, no file collisions expected
- Phase 2: #327 + #329 — depend on #326 profiles API
- Phase 3: #328 — depends on moderation controls in #330 and feed in #327

## Team assignment
All M5 issues → GROWTH team. Scope matches GROWTH mandate (social, discovery, community).

## Key design decisions (to document as ADRs)
- Social data model: separate from collection domain or embedded?
- Feed architecture: pull (fan-out-on-read) vs push (fan-out-on-write)?
- Profile public/private model: reuse #339 data classification?
- Recommendations: deterministic rules first, ML/LLM later?
- Offline classification: all social mutations explicitly online-only?

## Exit gates (from #355)
- [ ] Privacy/moderation threat model approved
- [ ] Abuse scenarios tested
- [ ] Social activation/retention metrics defined
- [ ] Private collection data cannot leak through social features (verified)

## Risks
| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Social features leak private collection data | #338 property-level authorization reused; profile visibility independent from collection data |
| Abuse before moderation controls deployed | #330 ships in Phase 1 alongside #326 |
| Feature creep into generic social media | Scope strictly limited to collection-centric actions; P2 items ship only after P1 proven |
| Offline/sync complexity for social mutations | Social mutations are server-authoritative; classified as online-only per M5 prereqs |
| GROWTH team dormant → ramp-up cost | Scope documented; existing patterns (auth, API, data model) reusable from M1–M4 |

## Changelog
- 2026-08-22: M5 launched. Phase 1 (#326, #330) assigned to GROWTH team.
